title: Moonsail Wellness — private onramp notes (pilot scoping)
content:
Meeting: Moonsail Wellness scoping call — 2025-02-10 10:00 PT (45m)
Attendees: Moonsail: Tara Iqbal (CTO), Ben Cho (Infra), Dana Ruiz (Lead ML Eng) — RW: Aisha, Liam, Priya, Evan
Quick context:
- Moonsail is a health & fitness coaching app with PHI-lite telemetry (user metrics + health goals). They want on-prem/VPC-hosted inference for recommendation + conversational assistant.
- Pilot: 2-node private deployment in their GCP us-west1 project (strict networking, KMS, audit logs). Target: replace current hosted LLM calls (3rd party) to reduce cost and improve latency to <120ms p50 for short chat flows.

Notes / ask flow (raw):
- They currently run nightly batch retrain and serve a small recommendation model + human-in-the-loop chat for coaching. Plan is to use Redwood for assistant + reranker + embeddings.
- Primary workloads: chat (seq len ~200 tokens typical), embedding generation (batch up to 8k rows/hr), rerank (small lists, latency sensitive). Estimated QPS: 8–12 chat req/s peak, 25 embed requests/min peak (bursty).
- Security: customer-managed KMS (Cloud KMS), VPC peering for control-plane comms, no public egress from nodes. They also require HSM for signing in prod later.
- Compliance: looks like non-PHI but sensitive PII; need full audit logs retention 6 months (we currently offer audit retention add-on).

Tech constraints / gotchas called out by Ben:
- Their infra team forbids node images with outbound internet access. So private-deploy must support an air-gapped bootstrap (we can do staged images + manifest verification). Action: confirm image pull method and offline bootstrap doc.
- They use shared VPC and strict firewall rules. Need clear list of firewall ports/IPs for agent/component comms (control plane, metrics, KV sync).
- They want predictable latency; cannot tolerate long cold-starts from disk (cold weights load time). Suggest warm pools + pinned model variant.

Model/serving decisions discussed:
- Candidate model family: open-weights rw-llama-13b / rw-llama-33b (balance quality vs memory). Dana prefers 33b quantized to int8 if we can hit latency SLOs.
- We recommended: start pilot on rw-llama-13b int8 for chat to meet latency, and separate dedicated pool for reranking (smaller model; faster).
- KV cache consideration: chat flows often have repeated prefixes (templates). Enable prefix caching on the proxy — reduces token cost and p95 latency for multi-turn. Need to capture typical prefix patterns from logs.

Operational items / SLOs:
- Latency SLO: p50 <120ms, p95 <450ms for chat (single-turn). If we can't hit these on 33b, fallback routing to 13b auto.
- Availability: pilot target 99.5% (monthly).
- Cost: they have tight monthly cap for pilot (~$8k/mo). Need capacity plan that fits reserved instance equivalent.

Open questions (to resolve before pilot kickoff):
- Exact public key for their KMS/HSM integration + approval flow for keys. (Ben)
- Are training artifacts allowed to be stored on same network? They want separation of training and serving nodes. We should recommend separate subnet for serving. (Aisha)
- Do they require SOC2 style evidence for our private agent images? They asked for SBOM and signed manifest. (Priya to collate existing SBOMs)

Immediate action items (owner, due):
- Aisha: draft offline bootstrap instructions + list of required images/artifacts (due 2025-02-13)
- Liam: firewall/IPs & ports matrix for control-plane + metrics + model-puller (due 2025-02-14)
- Priya: collect SBOM + signed manifest examples; find HSM/KMS integration checklist (due 2025-02-16)
- Evan: initial capacity estimate for 2-node vs 3-node pool (cost + expected latency) + suggestion for warm pool config (due 2025-02-14)
- Ben (customer): confirm whether embedding workload can be batched on their side (they prefer server-side batching) and provide sample traffic CSV (due 2025-02-17)

Pilot run plan (rough):
- Week 0: contract + access provisioning (service account, VPC peering, KMS key creation).
- Week 1: offline image delivery + deploy to their staging subnet; run smoke tests (latency, correctness).
- Week 2: perf tuning: enable batching, KV cache, quantization profile; run load tests with sample logs.
- Week 3–4: invite small group of beta users; collect evals; iterate.

Notes on fallback/routing policy we suggested (brainstorm):
- Primary pool: 13b-int8 (pinned) — for user-facing chat to guarantee latency.
- Secondary pool: 33b-quant (cold) — heavy content generation or longer context flows; use routing policy: if p95 > threshold OR instance unavailable, route to primary 13b.
- Cost-aware knob: autoscale buffer + burst credits; recommend small reserved baseline to keep warm cache + ephemeral burst for load spikes.

Risks flagged:
- Air-gapped bootstrap complexity may add 1–2 weeks to timeline if images require customer security review.
- KMS/HSM integration timing depends on their internal approvals (Ben said this may be slow).

Misc scribbles / test prompts they wanted to evaluate:
- "You are a supportive fitness coach; reframe goal-setting using user's last 7-day activity."
- Rerank test: reorder top-10 micro-workouts by predicted engagement probability.

Next sync: 2025-02-20 09:30 PT (tentative) — aim to confirm image delivery approach and get sample traffic CSV.

Other references:
- Internal deck: /shared_drives/engineering/private-deploys/moonsail-pilot-slides (ask product ops to export)
- Linear: LR-2143 (onprem-image-signing)
